feeds.title: Bianca Dottin Blog
feeds.description: Bianca Dottin, a vibrant lifestyle expert and mama, resides in sunny Orlando, FL. With a degree in Communications from UCF, she's an adventurer passionate about travelling, food, and photography. Through her blog, she inspires moms to embrace motherhood, married life, style, travel, and family recipes, fostering a life they adore, one day at a time.

feeds.title: Mom to Mom Nutrition
feeds.description: Hi, I am Katie Serbinski, a registered dietitian and millennial mom. I created Mom to Mom Nutrition to share real-life stories and tips about what works and what doesn't when it comes to raising a healthy family. TI'm on a mission to make mealtime happier, healthier, and easier with small children, despite what my 3 toddlers have me believing.

feeds.title: Twins Mommy Blog
feeds.description: Elna, a Millennial mom to twins who works from home as a freelance writer helps stay-at-home moms and mom bloggers become successful mompreneurs.

feeds.title: Sincerely Onyi
feeds.description: I'm Onyi, a physician assistant, millennial mommy, and a long distance wife. My goal is to help like minded women find balance in this crazy thing we call life. Sincerely Onyi has a focus on parenting, lifestyle, beauty, travel, marriage and the healthcare industry.

feeds.title: The Millennial Stay-At-Home Mom
feeds.description: I'm Kermilia! I'm an introverted millennial, married to the love of my life, and a SAHM to two amazing little boys and one sweet baby girl. I'm a Christian, self-proclaimed cup connoisseur, audiobook collector, and the queen of 5 ingredient recipes.

feeds.title: Smart Mom Ideas
feeds.description: Hey everyone! I'm Cathy, a Millennial mom, who loves finding hacks and smarter ways for a better home and blog! From parenting to budgeting to blogging to organizing and more, Smart Mom Ideas is for moms who want a smarter way of life!

feeds.title: Shandean Reid
feeds.description: I'm Shandean, a millennial, family and lifestyle blogger sharing transparent tidbits of what it's like being an all-rounded millennial. I'm a girl mama of one, physician's wife, author, entrepreneur and content creator based in Kingston, Jamaica. I blog about my love of family, motherhood, documenting and sharing lifestyle tips, hacks, reviewing products and share experiences.

feeds.title: The Purposeful Nest
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ashley. A cop turned stay-at-home-momma with a thing for children's books and crafts. Here at The Purposeful Nest, I share fun DIY projects, our homeschooling adventures, family travel, and other random happenings that I hope you will find both interesting and helpful.

feeds.title: Jalisa Harris
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jalisa. A Millennial mom of 2 in New England. I'm here to help you live your best life the simple way. I share all things to help you be that cool mom with Mom lifestyle, mom hacks, simple recipes and wellness.

feeds.title: Kin Unplugged
feeds.description: Family is an incredible thing. Some we're born into and others we choose. Find the pregnancy, marriage & baby lessons I learn along the way! I provide millennial women with a space where they can find helpful information to make their everyday lives easier as they become mothers & grow their families.

feeds.title: The Momfluence Blog
feeds.description: My name is Steph. Concurring mom life in crazy LA and sometimes south FL. On this blog, you will find just about everything from parenting, marriage, lifestyle and more!

feeds.title: Pretty Passive
feeds.description: I'm Ashley. A millennial, wife, mom, floridian, and relaxaholic. I'm embracing all things basic, while pursuing a creative outlet away from my current lifestyle.

feeds.title: Blissful Blooming
feeds.description: Gwen is an excited newbie in the wonderful realms of wifeyhood and motherhood. She is a millennial working mom continuously honing her skills in Marketing and Communications. The articles on this blog are precious products crafted during the Author's introverting moments while commuting, waiting in the queue, doing the laundry or nursing the baby.

feeds.title: Hispanic Mama Blog
feeds.description: ¡Hola! I'm Linda! I'm a millennial mom based in Raleigh, NC. I am the voice behind Hispanic Mama: a culture, food and travel blog showcasing my passion for cultural awareness and bilingualism.

feeds.title: The Millennial Modern Mom Blog
feeds.description: Discover how to empower yourself as a mom with our tips and advice. From self-care to setting boundaries, learn to prioritize your needs and become a confident and fulfilled parent. Rave, a mom of three, created The Millennial Modern Mom for moms wanting to create their ideal life through an abundance mindset, time management, wellness, and living authentically.

feeds.title: Pink April Diary
feeds.description: A Style & Beauty Blog for Busy Millennial Women who are looking to conquer their lives with style. Here you will find everyday style guides, Outfit Ideas, Beauty Tutorials that fits a busy lifestyle.

feeds.title: Hot Mess Goes To OZ
feeds.description: Life in Motion as a Single Millennial Momma! Mom Humor, Dating, Travel, Mom Tips and Reviews, Deals and more!

feeds.title: The Blessed Mess Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ryan and I am the voice of The Blessed Mess Blog! I am a wife, new Mom to my son, Liam. This blog is where I post about parenting wins and Mom life, my love of food, beauty, fitness and finding balance in this blessed, but sometimes messy, life of mine!

feeds.title: Millennial Moms Marketing Blog
feeds.description: Moms Maria Bailey has long had a passion for helping mothers find the answers they need to become better parents. The show tackles everything from calming chaos with kids to dinner and diapers and features parenting experts, authors and mom celebrities.

feeds.title: Real Time Mom Blog
feeds.description: Tips and tricks on maternity, food and health, baby essentials, nursery and more. Real Time Mom blog was started in 2017 by Nancy Fulkerson.

feeds.title: Be Bright Daily
feeds.description: Be Bright Daily is a lifestyle blog for the millennial mommy, college cutie, and business babe! I believe it is important to be a reminder to myself and to others to always 'Be Bright.'

feeds.title: Mindfulness Mama
feeds.description: Mindfulness Mama is written for Millennial Moms by a Millennial Mom. Editor, Jennifer Landis, shares her thoughts and tips on healthy living, relationships, mindfulness, and momming like a boss.

feeds.title: Signed Samantha
feeds.description: Signed, Samantha is a lifestyle blog for the millennial mom trying to balance it all; encompassing food, home decor, toddler activities, and much more.

feeds.title: Jessica Simien
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Jessica! Welcome to my blog! Here you'll find posts about beauty, hair, what it's like being a millennial mom and a little of my life in between. I hope you are inspired and can relate.

feeds.title: Start a Mom Blog
feeds.description: Six years ago I started this little website to help other moms with the tech and strategy behind growing a successful blog. This website was created specifically for moms who want to learn how to start and grow their blogs. If that's you, you're in the right place!

feeds.title: Millennial Moms PH
feeds.description: MILLENNIAL MOMS PH is a young, fun-loving and supportive community of moms dedicated to bring out the best in a woman through motherhood. Founded by Bernadette Zulueta, a millennial and mom of two lovely girls, it aims to provide moms online and offline venues where moms may share, inspire and connect with fellow moms.

feeds.title: Millennial Mom Florida
feeds.description: Mom things, Nerd things, Utter Nonsense, Real Life, All things that are of interest to this Millennial Mom!
